text: Deep in a beautiful forest lived a little girl with curly golden hair — everyone called her Goldilocks! One morning, she skipped into the forest to explore, even though her mother had told her not to wander too far.

Soon Goldilocks came upon a cozy little cottage with a bright red door. She knocked — no answer! The three bears who lived there had just gone for a walk while their porridge cooled.

Goldilocks pushed the door open and stepped inside. "Hello?" she called.

On the kitchen table were three bowls of porridge. Goldilocks was hungry!

She tried the biggest bowl — "Too HOT!" Then the middle bowl — "Too COLD!" Finally the tiny little bowl — "MMM! Just right!" She ate every single spoonful.

In the living room were three chairs. She tried the big chair — "Too hard!" The medium chair — "Too soft!" Then the teeny tiny chair — "Just right!"

But she rocked too hard and… CRACK! The little chair broke into pieces! Goldilocks jumped up with a squeak.

Upstairs were three beds. Goldilocks yawned sleepily. She tried the big bed — "Too hard!" The medium bed — "Too lumpy!" Then the tiny little bed — "Ohhh, just perfect!"

She snuggled in and fell fast asleep, her golden curls spread over the pillow.

Just then, the three bears came home — big Papa Bear, medium Mama Bear, and tiny Baby Bear. Papa Bear growled, "Someone's been eating MY porridge!" Mama Bear gasped, "Someone's been eating MINE!" Baby Bear wailed, "Someone ate ALL of mine!"

They searched the house and found their chairs disturbed and Baby Bear's chair in pieces! Then they tiptoed upstairs — and there was Goldilocks, fast asleep in Baby Bear's bed!

Baby Bear squeaked, "Someone's sleeping in MY bed!" Goldilocks woke with a gasp and scrambled out the window!

Goldilocks ran home as fast as her legs could carry her. She was safe, but very, very sorry. She told her mother everything and promised never to enter someone's home without permission again.

🌟 THE END 🌟

💡 Moral: Always respect other people's belongings!
